titulo: Le / les become se before lo, la, los, las
subtitulo: Se lo dije, dáselo, quiero comprárselos.
regla: When le or les (to him/her/them) comes before lo, la, los or las (it/them), it becomes se: se lo di (not le lo di). Indirect pronoun first, direct second.

bloques.texto: Indirect object pronouns are **me, te, le, nos, les**. Direct object pronouns for things and people are **lo, la, los, las**.
When both appear together, the **indirect** one goes **first**. But **le** or **les** + **lo / la / los / las** sounds clumsy, so **le / les** turns into **se**.

partes: → se lo, se la, se los, se las

bloques.texto: **Se** doesn't show if it's _him, her, you_ or _them_. Add **a él / a ella / a usted / a ellos** if you need to be clear.
Tip: two **l**'s can't sit together, so the first one turns into **se**.
With a **conjugated verb**: in front, as separate words: **se la dimos**.
With an **infinitive**, **gerund** or **affirmative command**: attached at the end (add an accent to keep the stress): **comprárselos**, **comprándoselos**, **cómpraselos**.
With an infinitive or gerund after another verb, you can also put both pronouns in front of the whole phrase, but **never in the middle**:

lista.en: I want to buy them for them.
María is buying them for him.

lista.es: ==Se lo== voy a dar cuando la vea.
lista.en: I'll give it to her when I see her.
Ask him about it right now.

lista.es: Las pantuflas, pón==selas== junto a la cama.
lista.en: The slippers, put them next to the bed for her.

lista.es: No ==se los== pagues, él tiene dinero.
lista.en: Don't pay for them for him, he has money.

bloques.texto: In Mexico, when **se** means _them_ (**les**), many people move the plural onto the direct pronoun: **se los dije** for _I told **them**_ (it), even if _it_ is singular. You'll hear it all the time. In writing, the standard form is **se lo dije**.

filas.t: Se lo voy a dar. / Voy a dárselo.

lista.texto: Direct object pronouns: [[5121|lo, la, los, las]].
Attaching pronouns: [[5140|position with infinitive, gerund, commands]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: Replace both objects: _Le di el libro a Ana._
Two ways: _I'm going to send it to him._
lista.r: Se lo voy a mandar. / Voy a mandárselo.
